newsitem.title: USA: Medaphis to amend credit facility terms.
newsitem.headline: Medaphis to amend credit facility terms.

text.p: Medaphis Corp said Friday it had reached an agreement with its lenders to amend "certain" terms and conditions of its $250 million revolving credit facilities.
The company said certain terms included adjustments to the interest rates, fees and charges that it would pay to the lenders.
They would also restrict cash dividends and redemptions, new acquisitions, as well as waivers of certain existing financial covenants for the fiscal quarter ended December 31, 1996, it said.
The company said it expected to comply with the terms and conditions of the amended credit facilities for the fourth quarter of 1996 and for the 1996 fiscal year.
Medaphis is an outsourcer of business systems and services.
